headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 13, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Leody Taveras leading the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Keegan Akin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Baltimore Orioles due to left elbow discomfort. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed Zac Gallen on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, with right elbow inflammation. Other teams have also made roster moves due to injuries, including the Texas Rangers, Cincinnati Reds, Miami Marlins, Milwaukee Brewers, Atlanta Braves, and Minnesota Twins.

As the trade deadline approaches, teams are making moves to bolster their rosters. The Pittsburgh Pirates have traded RHP Cam Sanders to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired SS Braden Shewmake from the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins have acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Brewers 14-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Milwaukee Brewers, winning 14-5 behind a strong performance from their offense. Henry Davis led the Pirates' charge with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered an 8-2 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles dominating the game from start to finish. Leody Taveras led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Curtis Mead leading the offense with a home run and one RBI. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win, while Paul Blackburn secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Reds 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-4 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Alex Bregman led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Update Player Status**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles have transferred left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort. This change in status affects Akin's availability for the team.

top_news.title: **Pirates Make Roster Move Ahead of Trade Deadline**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have traded RHP Cam Sanders to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. This move comes as the Pirates continue to navigate the 2026 MLB season.
